chu_de: CHI THI #7: nhan symbol sai + lich su lenh 1 con qua Chrome CDP
noi_dung:
CHI THI #7 (cloud -> nha). Doc ket qua cua nha roi: cam on, tot. Da kiem: _url_de_tai (69b536a) dung. Cloud them: duong Chrome (CDP) cung dung URL www + /en (cung loi 404 gia), thu phan neo #!tab=history, tham do tra them symbol_chinh. Code o commit ea5f288 (git pull truoc).
(1) NHAN SYMBOL SAI: con 2196457 la vang that. Goc: _quet_signal_mql5._RX_SYM dem chu hoa 6 ky tu CA TRANG, bo sot GOLD# / XAUUSDm. Cloud viet link_nguon.phan_bo_symbol/chuan_symbol + lenh `b link ho-so-symbol`; DON `link-ho-so-symbol` da xep hang (lan MANG, ~5 phut): runner `b cau chay` lam, ket qua reports/nguoi_thang_symbol.json (31 con song >=2 nam: symbol chinh that + ty le lenh + nhan cu dung/sai). KHONG sua tay file do.
(2) VIEC CHINH TOI NAY = LICH SU LENH cua MOT con (tab History, khong co trong HTML tinh). Con cong khai, KHONG dang nhap, dung ho so Chrome cua bot (khong dung ho so ca nhan cua chu du an). Lam: `python mo_chrome_cdp.py` (neu chua bat) -> `b link tham-do https://mql5.com/signals/2196457 --cdp` -> `b link chia-se <ma>` (ma = ma bam 10 ky tu in ra; ghi de ban HTTP: duoc) -> xem reports/link_tham_do_<ma>.json muc xhr / tab_lich_su: ghi TEN end point tra danh sach lenh + co can dang nhap khong. Neu CDP khong ra: tai file JS cong khai ma trang goi (muc script_nguon: c.mql5.com/js/signals.*.js) va liet ke chuoi giong duong dan co 'history|deals|trades|export' (chi TEN) -> reports/mql5_signals_diem_cuoi.txt. Khi biet end point: lay thu 1 trang dau (<= 30 KB, khong token/cookie) -> reports/mql5_lich_su_mau.json. KHONG cao hang loat truoc khi cloud viet bo doc.
(3) Chon con mau dau tien SAU khi co nguoi_thang_symbol.json: uu tien con co symbol_chinh = AUDCAD >= 80% lenh va song lau nhat (luoi.py chay DUNG y het cho AUDCAD); khong co thi lay vang va bao chu du an cai/dang nhap MT5 XM demo de do quy cach (symbol_info) + M1.
(4) Khi ranh: `pip install ziglang` roi `python -m nhan.luoi_nhan trang-thai` / `do 190000` (nhan C), `b tran-cpu 78`, dien muc 9 tai_lieu/MAY_NHA_TOI_UU.md bang so do that (lay tu may-do-nhanh-dau).
BAO CAO: 3-8 dong loi thuong cho chu du an (xong / chua / ket o dau / can chu du an lam gi); so lieu dai vao reports/<ten>.md. Phan doi chi thi thi nuoc mot lan kem bang chung. Dung hoi chu du an ve bot cu hay so tai khoan.
